hypothesis: Explicit BTC forced-liquidation labels may recover a selective long opportunity absent from V58: forced short-liquidation buying may continue when post-burst price and public flow persist, while forced long-liquidation selling may produce a distinct exhaustion-reclaim long. These are competing causal mechanisms and neither edge is established.
decision: Reject both frozen BTC liquidation-triggered long branches in development and keep validation and pseudo-holdout sealed. The primary 5s_p95 five-minute continuation branch retained 81 resolved observations, lost 9.1711 basis points on average after modeled costs and 371.43 US dollars in aggregate, and had a fully negative 95-percent stationary-day interval. The exhaustion-reclaim branch retained 60, lost 4.8718 basis points on average and 146.15 US dollars in aggregate, and had a confidence interval spanning zero. Neither branch satisfied retained-count, mean, lower-bound, Holm, or doubled-impact-stress requirements; continuation also had materially negative months. Diagnostic regimes, arms, and horizons cannot rescue either primary result. Do not open later partitions, retune this hypothesis on development outcomes, or add a live BTC long from this mechanism. Preserve V58 unchanged.
falsifier: Update this rejection only if an independently identified implementation or source-integrity defect changes the frozen eligible set, overlap retention, exact after-cost PnL, or preregistered statistics, or if a genuinely new preregistered mechanism with independently acquired evidence is evaluated as a separate hypothesis. Merely selecting a favorable regime, arm, horizon, month, or threshold from these development outcomes does not falsify the rejection.

evidence.role: primary branch gates, bootstrap, monthly, concentration, and regime results
independent exact-Decimal purge, count, mean, and PnL reconciliation

limitations: This rejection applies to the frozen liquidation-triggered continuation and exhaustion-reclaim mechanisms, not to every possible BTC long design.
Development evidence was historical and execution was modeled from visible public depth; actual IOC latency, hidden liquidity, and live account funding rounding remain unobserved.
Continuation retained 81 and exhaustion retained 60 observations, so both also failed the minimum frequency screen before untouched validation.
Some descriptive regime strata were positive, but selecting them after outcome inspection would be leakage and is prohibited under this hypothesis.
No validation, pseudo-holdout, shared-portfolio, or prospective result was opened because no branch advanced.
No strategy, order, position, risk limit, or live process changed.
This revision cannot pause, retune, route, size, enter, close, restart, or promote a live strategy or lifecycle.
